title: Nutty Crispy Filipino Peanuts Kare Kare
description: A funky, crispy, energizing Filipino dish featuring vegan butter and binchotan-charcoal, this macrobiotic-friendly kare-kare is a unique twist on a classic recipe. It combines the richness of peanuts with the crunch of crispy elements.
instructions: Heat the vegan butter in a large skillet over medium heat until melted.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook until fragrant and lightly browned.
Add the binchotan-charcoal and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the rice flour and water until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the vegetable oil, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the kare-kare hot, garnished with additional chopped peanuts if desired.
